subject: Session churn causing vendor onboarding upload to fail - ZenMetrix
messages:
From: Emma Zhao <emma@zenmetrix.com>
To: mateo.alvarez@redwood-inference.com
Cc: ben.carter@redwood-inference.com
Date: 2026-08-01T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Portal session churn blocking vendor onboarding (invoice + bank form)

Hi Mateo / Ben,

We're trying to finish vendor onboarding in your supplier portal (Coupa integration) and keep getting logged out mid-flow while uploading the W-9 and bank details. The user sees "Session timed out" and gets redirected to the SSO login after completing the multi-step form; the uploaded file shows a 302 then a fresh session cookie being issued which drops the step state.

Repro steps (user report):
1) Sign in via Okta SSO (zenmetrix.okta.com)
2) Start vendor onboarding > Supplier profile > Tax & bank > Upload W-9
3) On upload completion the page redirects to /onboard/step3 then immediately to /auth/sso?redirect=...
4) Network HAR attached (zen_upload_trace.har) — you can see a Set-Cookie: session=... replaced by session=... at 15:09:47 PDT

Timestamps (user timezone PDT): Aug 1 15:09:47, 15:10:12
Affected user: emma.zhao@zenmetrix.com (internal ops user)
Browser: Chrome 114 on macOS
Attachments: zen_screenshot_upload_error.png, zen_upload_trace.har

This is blocking three vendors today — can we get an urgent look? Happy to jump on a call.

Thanks,
Emma Zhao
Vendor Ops
ZenMetrix
emma@zenmetrix.com
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood-inference.com>
To: Emma Zhao <emma@zenmetrix.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2026-08-01T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Portal session churn blocking vendor onboarding (invoice + bank form)

Hi Emma — thanks for the detail and the HAR, that helps a lot.

Short version: we suspect a cookie-affinity / SameSite handling issue at the Azure App Gateway layer that is causing session rotation when the upload POST returns a 302. Ben and I are pulling logs now.

Immediate asks:
- Can you confirm if affected users are behind a corporate proxy or using a security appliance that might strip or rewrite cookies? (ops-team@zenmetrix.com was CCed)
- If you can reproduce, please capture one more HAR that includes the initial Okta SSO flow (from /sso/login) and send over.

Temporary mitigation I can enable from our side: a test link that forces session-binding via a short-lived query token (expires 1 hour) so uploads skip the redirect dance. If you'd like that, tell me a good 30–60 minute window and I'll spin it up.

I'll keep you posted — looping in Laura to coordinate any contract-impacting escalations.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Customer Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood-inference.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood-inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2026-08-01T16:32:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Portal session churn blocking vendor onboarding (engineering notes)

Forwarding internal notes from infra after a quick look — excerpted below. Attaching a short log snippet and a proposed runbook patch.

----- BEGIN EXCERPT -----
15:09:47.123 INFO http request POST /onboard/upload 200 -> 302 (user 4582) Set-Cookie: session=abc123; Path=/; HttpOnly; Secure
15:09:47.125 WARN lb affinity cookie mismatch: requested cookie '__AppAffinity' missing, backend issued new session id
15:09:47.127 INFO authentication: redirect to /auth/sso?reason=session_reset

Root cause hypothesis: when the upload triggers a 302 to an external S3 endpoint and the App Gateway strips or reorders cookies (SameSite lax vs none), the backend treats this as a new session and issues a new session cookie — stateful flow is lost.

Immediate mitigation suggestions (can be applied as <5m config change):
- Set Set-Cookie attributes to SameSite=None; Secure and use __Host- prefix to prevent path scoping issues
- Enable sticky session on the App Gateway for the /onboard/* path (cookie-based affinity)
- Add short-lived POST-to-get redirect handshake (our temporary query-token option) while we verify

Next steps: coordinate with ZenMetrix infra to check intermediary proxies. If agreed, we can schedule the sticky cookie change at 23:00 PDT tonight with a 30-min observation window.
----- END EXCERPT -----

Attachments: engineer-log-snippet.txt, runbook-cookie-fix.md

I'll stand by to apply the change once we have customer sign-off. CC'ing Laura for any procurement/SLAs notes.

-Ben
